# Wassette v0.8.1

This patch release hardens the boundary between component acquisition and host
permissions, makes policy-free execution deny environment access by default,
and updates audited runtime dependencies.

## Security and permissions

- OCI artifacts containing publisher-supplied policies are rejected by default.
  After reviewing a policy, a direct operator can activate it explicitly with
  `wassette component load <OCI-URI> --trust-bundled-policy`; automated and
  agent-facing load paths remain fail closed.
- Components without an attached policy no longer receive configured environment
  values or stored secrets. Deployments that relied on ambient inheritance must
  grant each required environment variable explicitly.
- Rejected OCI policy loads preserve the previously installed component, policy,
  metadata, and precompiled cache.

## Maintenance

- Updated Wasmtime, quinn-proto, and rustls to patched releases.
- Updated example policies and workflows to document the explicit permissions
  required by each component.
